t.zh: 一个分类器的作者说：「它在任何背景下都认得出猫。」检查台拿到一批样例，每个样例有人工标注的真实类别和分类器的预测，还有预测的置信度。
t.en: The author of a classifier claims: 'it recognises a cat against any background.' The station receives a batch of cases, each with its labelled true class, the classifier's prediction and the confidence of that prediction.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：分类器在一张照片上答对了，而且很有把握，这能说明它换了背景也认得出吗？选出一个能推翻这句话的样例；一个也没有时，选「没有」。
t.en: This level asks: when a classifier gets one photo right, and confidently, does that show it will recognise the cat against other backgrounds? Choose a case that refutes the claim; when there is none, choose 'none'.

after.zh: 输入有无关的变化时输出仍然可靠，叫<wiki-ref to="robustness"></wiki-ref>：答对一次证明不了，一个反例就能推翻。
after.en: Staying reliable when irrelevant things about the input change is <wiki-ref to="robustness"></wiki-ref>: one right answer cannot prove it, one counterexample refutes it.

brief.zh: 选出能推翻「它在任何背景下都认得出猫」的样例；没有就选「没有」。
brief.en: Choose a case that refutes 'it recognises a cat against any background'; if there is none, choose 'none'.

hint.zh: 置信度说的是分类器自己有多肯定，不是它对不对：逐个把预测和标注对一对。
hint.en: The confidence says how sure the classifier is, not whether it is right: check each prediction against its label.

why.zh: 这个样例的预测和标注一致：答对的样例，置信度再高，也推翻不了「任何背景下都认得出」。要找的是预测和标注不一致的那个。
why.en: This case's prediction matches its label: a right answer, however confident, cannot refute 'recognises it against any background'. Look for a case whose prediction differs from its label.
